name: claude-local-telemetry
description: Local observability for Claude Code: an OTLP/HTTP-JSON sink that writes live metrics, events and traces into SQLite, a backfill that imports the transcripts already on disk, and an MCP server that queries both. Answers cost, audit and per-plugin attribution questions without sending telemetry anywhere. TypeScript on Node 24 using node:sqlite, so there is no npm install, no build step and no collector; loopback only. Not for hosted observability backends, and not a replacement for the Claude Code analytics dashboard.
